main[data-land]{background-color:var(--land);background-image:var(--motif);background-size:162px 132px;color:#222f2d}
main[data-land] #app{background:transparent}main[data-land] header,main[data-land] nav{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pane) 88%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--edge) 50%,transparent)}
main[data-land] .pad{padding-bottom:22px}
main[data-land] .back{color:var(--accent);font-weight:650}
main[data-land] .locbutton, main[data-land] .scard,main[data-land] .drawer{background:var(--pane);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--edge) 55%,transparent);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin:9px 0;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #243b3610}
main[data-land] .scard{padding:14px}main[data-land] .drawer{padding:15px}
main[data-land] .locbutton img{border-radius:7px;width:83px;height:61px}
main[data-land] .pad>p:not(.notice), main[data-land] .pad>.notice{background:var(--pane);padding:11px 13px;border-radius:9px}
main[data-land] .pad>.detailTitle,main[data-land] .pad>h2{background:var(--land);width:fit-content;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 5px}
main[data-land] .stamp,main[data-land] .arr,main[data-land] .series,main[data-land] .placeShot figcaption,main[data-land] nav .on,main[data-land] nav .on svg{color:var(--accent)}
main[data-land] .solid{background:var(--accent)}main[data-land] .placeShot figcaption{padding:5px 8px;background:var(--pane)}
.folio{margin-top:21px;padding:9px 2px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--edge);font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.folio span,.folio b{background:var(--land);padding:0 4px}.folio b{font:700 10px Consolas;letter-spacing:1.6px}
#welcome{width:min(100%,440px);height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;max-width:100%;margin:auto;padding:0;border:0;background:#faf8ef;color:#233d30}#welcome::backdrop{background:#16291dcc}.poster{height:100%;background-size:cover;background-position:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;color:white}.wtop,.wrow,.prefShortcut{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.wtop{padding:24px 18px;background:linear-gradient(#162a22aa,transparent)}.wtop b{font-size:23px;letter-spacing:-1px}.poster button{color:white;background:#17281b66;border-radius:24px;padding:9px 12px}.poster button:disabled{visibility:hidden}.wbase{padding:18px 22px 35px}.wbase h1{font-size:40px;margin:10px 0}.wbase p{max-width:300px;line-height:1.8}.wrow{margin-top:26px}.wrow button:last-child{background:#f4e9cc;color:#203d2f;font-weight:bold}.pref{padding:clamp(30px,12vh,120px) 24px 20px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 6%,#d9e7ca,transparent 48%);min-height:100%}.pref h1{font-size:34px;margin:12px 0}.pref p{color:#59695b}.ig{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:26px 0}.ig button{padding:13px 4px;border:1px solid #b9c6b3;border-radius:12px;background:#fffdf5}.ig button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#254c39;color:white}.pref button:disabled{opacity:.48}.pref .back{margin-top:15px}.prefShortcut{margin:0 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #d4d9ce;padding-bottom:8px}.prefShortcut small{font-size:11px;color:#5b695b}
